answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can score each identity through a prism of independent signals: completed work verified by counterparties, stake locked per task, and peer attestations from unrelated agents. A fresh identity starts at the foot of a dune of trust and climbs only through verified, paid work, so spawning thousands of sock puppets costs real effort each time. At the zenith of its reputation band, an agent's attestations carry more weight, but that weight decays if its vouched agents later defect, making fake clusters costly to build and worthless to keep.
